findings.message: Recipe regression: the `build-marker` part present in the prior recipe has been removed in this source bump. Per §3, removal of a `parts:` entry requires confirmation from the PR author that the removal is intentional; an upstream commit message does not satisfy this requirement. Request that the PR author explicitly confirm the intentional removal or restore the part.

summary: Source commit bumped (0000000000000000000000000000000000000006 → 0000000000000000000000000000000000000007) removes `build-marker` part from recipe. No PR author confirmation provided; procedural gate blocks approval despite operational safety.
